sources.fact: Regulation 19 materials separately list AJ Gascoigne Estate East as a site allocation evidence document.
Gascoigne Estate East planning history includes a site-wide maximum of 1,575 residential dwellings through the hybrid permission chain.
Phases 2B and 2C reserved matters comprised 526 dwellings and associated commercial/public realm works.
21/01913/REM related to Phases 2B, 2C and 2D within the varied Gascoigne East permission and described up to 546 units in that phase package.
21/01076/FULL sought 334 homes for Gascoigne Estate East Phase 3B; 53% of units were described as affordable.
October 2022 Cabinet approved the Phase 3B redevelopment project around a 334-home delivery package and construction contract arrangements.
February 2026 Cabinet considered disposal/lease arrangements for a further 854 homes across Beam Park and Gascoigne East Phase 3B combined.
The 854-home figure is combined across two developments and is not assigned wholesale to Gascoigne East.
The 2026 Cabinet minutes list specific Gascoigne East Phase 3B new-build addresses to be leased after practical completion.
Phase 3B affordability information applies to that phase only and is not extrapolated to the whole AJ masterplan.
Exact application references remain required for current phase status; no phase is merged into a synthetic whole-site completion record.
Historic appropriation/development-vehicle decisions support regeneration delivery but are not exact current HMLR title/proprietor bindings.

examples.result: The 1,575-home masterplan maximum is kept distinct from individual reserved/full phase permissions.
526-unit and 546-unit phase records are not added together without checking whether their scopes overlap.
21/01076/FULL is retained as the 334-home Phase 3B case.
2022 construction approval is delivery evidence, not title evidence.
The 2026 854-home figure is combined Beam Park + Gascoigne East Phase 3B and is not allocated entirely to AJ.
Listed 2026 lease addresses demonstrate delivery assets but not whole-AJ completion.
Promotion remains zero until exact canonical parcel/title relation and executed statutory overlays are verified.
